parameters.content:
## Travel: Log Booking (1 of 2)

**Flow:** Gmail Trigger (all inbox mail) → Prep Booking Email (keyword-filtered) → Build Gemini Request → Gemini (extracts booking details) → Parse & Build Row → Google Sheets Append → Slack notify → Gmail: Mark Processed.

This is the REACTIVE half — it logs one row per booking confirmation as it arrives, tagging each with a tripTag (destination + month/year) so multiple bookings for the same trip group together automatically. The companion workflow ("Travel: Consolidated Itinerary") reads this same Sheet on a schedule and posts one chronological digest per upcoming trip.

**IMPORTANT — execution modes:** `Build Gemini Request` and `Parse & Build Row` are set to "Run Once for Each Item". `Prep Booking Email` uses the default "Run Once for All Items".

**Before activating:**
1. Credentials: Gmail (trigger, label), Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets, Slack.
2. `Prep Booking Email`: set EXEC_EMAIL; widen BOOKING_KEYWORDS if real confirmations use different phrasing.
3. Sheet headers (create first, in this order): emailId, threadId, type, tripTag, provider, confirmationNumber, startDateTime, endDateTime, startHasTime, location, summaryLine, confidence, notes, status, loggedAt — then set Document + Sheet in `Google Sheets: Append Row`. BOTH workflows must point at the exact same sheet.
4. `Gmail: Mark Processed`: pick a real label.
5. `Slack: Notify`: confirm channel.

**IMPORTANT when reimporting after any future fix:** select all nodes (Ctrl+A) and delete them BEFORE importing, or n8n will auto-rename nodes with a trailing "1" and break every cross-node reference.
